purpose: Assesses whether the organization can detect adversary behavior specifically designed to blend in and avoid raising alerts, even while defenses remain technically intact.
summary: Stealth (formerly part of Defense Evasion, split out in ATT&CK v19) consists of techniques adversaries use to avoid detection through behavioral camouflage, such as masquerading as legitimate processes, living-off-the-land using trusted system binaries, or obfuscating payloads, without actually disabling or breaking security tools.
expectedStatementElements: How the organization detects living-off-the-land binary (LOLBin) abuse and masquerading of legitimate processes
What behavioral/anomaly-based detection exists beyond signature matching to catch obfuscated or camouflaged activity
How process and file integrity are monitored to detect impersonation of trusted system components
How the organization stays current on emerging stealth techniques since this tactic was newly separated in ATT&CK v19
evidenceExamples: Behavioral/anomaly detection rules covering LOLBin abuse and process masquerading
EDR configuration showing detection beyond signature-based matching
File and process integrity monitoring configuration
Evidence that detection content has been updated to reflect the Stealth/Defense Impairment split (v19)
commonGaps: Detection relies primarily on signatures and would miss obfuscated or living-off-the-land activity
No monitoring distinguishes a legitimate system binary's normal use from its abuse to blend in
File and process integrity aren't monitored closely enough to catch impersonation of trusted components
Detection content and coverage maps haven't been updated since the Stealth/Defense Impairment split in ATT&CK v19
interviewQuestions: Would you catch an attacker using a legitimate system tool to quietly carry out malicious activity?
Does your detection go beyond known signatures to catch obfuscated or camouflaged behavior?
How would you know if a trusted process were actually being impersonated?
Has your detection coverage been updated to reflect the newer Stealth tactic, separate from Defense Impairment?
